name: Titanium.Android.QuickSettingsService
summary: Android service for creating custom quick settings tiles and handling user's interaction with them.
description:
A special kind of service providing access to a tile in the quick settings menu. Used for customization
and event handling of the tile. Usage is similar to default [Titanium.Android.Service](api:Titanium.Android.Service) but with the
addition of some specific attributes and methods. This service is not started from within the application 
with the help of an Intent, but instead whenever the custom tile is added in the quick settings menu by the
user. Applications can have multiple tiles in the quick settings menu, but a [Titanium.Android.QuickSettingsService](api:Titanium.Android.QuickSettingsService)
corresponds to a single one - you need separate service file for every tile.

To create a service file:

  1. Write the JavaScript code you want the service to execute in a separate file.
     The service can execute any Titanium APIs but you should only use non-UI APIs.
  2. Register the service in your `tiapp.xml` file. Refer to the example below.

  Icons used for the 'icon' attribute in the service declaration in tiapp.xml must
  be in the Android drawables folder, so they you should be put under
  `platform/android/res/drawable`
  Icons added with the setIcon method can be outside the directory.

To get a reference to the `Service` inside the JavaScript service code, use the
[Titanium.Android.currentService](api:Titanium.Android#currentService) property to retrieve a reference to the service,

Further Reading:

  * [Android Quick Settings Tile API](https://developer.android.com/about/versions/nougat/android-7.0.html#tile_api)

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description:
Creates and shows a default Alert dialog with the provided options dictionary.

Note: Alert dialog only supports one of the following: message/options.
If you pass both - only `message` will be shown.

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary: Dictionary containing the options for the dialog.

inlined.name: QuickSettingsServiceShowParams
inlined.summary: Dictionary of options for the [Titanium.Android.QuickSettingsService.showDialog](api:Titanium.Android.QuickSettingsService#showDialog) method.

properties.name: buttonNames
properties.description:
They will be shown as buttons' titles. They are limited up
to three buttons and with a predefined order - positive, neutral, negative. See events.

properties.name: message
properties.summary: String to be used as a message for the dialog.

properties.name: options
properties.description: They will be shown as a single choice list.

properties.name: title
properties.summary: String to be used as title for the dialog.

methods.name: startActivityAndCollapse
methods.summary: Collapses the quick settings menu and starts an activity for the passed Intent.

methods.name: unlockAndRun
methods.summary: Prompts the user to unlock the device and runs the JS code.

methods.name: updateTile
methods.description: Updates the Tile's with it's current label, icon and state.

events.name: startlistening
events.description: Dispatched whenever the user has opened the quick setting menu and the Tile is added in there.

events.name: stoplistening
events.summary: Tile has stopped listening for events.
events.description: Dispatched whenever the user has collapsed the quick setting menu and the Tile is not visible.

events.name: tileadded
events.summary: The Tile has been added in the quick menu.
events.description: Dispatched whenever the user has moved the Tile for this service in the quick settings menu.

events.name: tiledialogcancelled
events.summary: Dispatched when the alert dialog has been cancelled.

events.name: tiledialognegative
events.summary: Dispatched when the negative (index 2) button has been clicked.

events.name: tiledialogneutral
events.summary: Dispatched when the neutral (index 1) button has been clicked.

events.name: tiledialogoptionselected
events.summary: An item from the single choice menu has been selected.

properties.name: itemIndex
properties.summary: Index of the selected item from the single choice menu in the dialog.

events.name: tiledialogpositive
events.summary: Dispatched when the positive (index 0) button has been clicked.

events.name: tileremoved
events.summary: The Tile has been removed from the quick menu.
events.description: Dispatched whenever the user has removed the Tile for this service from the quick settings menu.
